topology_rules.heaviside_set: Omega_i minus actual Gamma has exactly two nonempty components on opposite y sides; all y=0 points in S_i lie on Gamma; dist(S_i,F)>0; source is off Gamma

local_exact_inclusion.coefficient_choice: front coefficient c=A*sqrt(R0); BASE coefficient c*Fbar(X_i) for every front support source; zero for other BASE sources
local_exact_inclusion.identity: sum_T phi_i*c*Fbar(X_i) + sum_T phi_i*c*(Fbar-Fbar(X_i)) = c*Fbar because every active source in the core is in T and sum_T phi_i=1

initial_front_core_batch.rule: polar GL4(r) x GL8(theta in open (-pi,pi)) x GL4(z)
